newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Tradehold to unbundle, delist from JSE.
newsitem.headline: Tradehold to unbundle, delist from JSE.

text.p: Tradehold Ltd said on Friday that it planned to unbundle and reconstitute itself as a wholly-owned subsidiary of Pepkor Ltd, delisting from the Johannesburg Stock Exchange.
Tradehold is an investment holding company which holds 73.6 percent of Shoprite Holdings Ltd.

"The rationale for the unbundling is to eliminate the discount at which the Tradehold ordinary shares have traded on the JSE compared to the market value of Tradehold's underlying investment in Shoprite," the company said.
Subject to the unbundling and the minority redemption and with effect from January 17, the JSE will terminate the listing of Tradehold.

- the distribution in specie by way of a dividend and a reduction of capital of a total of 358 million Shoprite shares on the basis of 1,305 Shoprite shares for every 100 Tradehold shares held on January 17.

- the redemption of the Tradehold preference shares at their original issue price amounting to 50 million rand in total, by way of a distribution in specie comprising a total of 8.5 million Shoprite shares at a price of 590 cents per Shoprite share.

- the repayment of 39 million rand effectively owing to Pepkor by the creation and issue of 38,597 Tradehold non-participating redeemable preference shares and the subsequent redemption of such preference shares by way of a distribution in specie comprising a total of 6.7 million Shoprite shares at the settlement price.
Twenty Shoprite shares will be retained by Tradehold.
The settlement price is the ruling market price per Shoprite share on the JSE on November 20.
Pursuant to the unbundling Tradehold will have a nominal net asset value of 20 Shoprite shares and will cease to exist as an investment holding company.

A minority redemption will convert all Tradehold ordinary shares held by the shareholders other than Pepkor into "A" redeemable preference shares with a par value of 0.0004 cents each and will see the subsequent redemption of such shares for cash.
The last day to register as a Tradehold shareholder is January 17.
A further announcement will be published on January 20.
